title: Amazon’s Globalstar Deal Recasts Satellite Ambitions And Investor Risk Reward
title_zh: 亚马逊的 Globalstar 交易重塑了卫星野心和投资者风险回报
summary: Amazon.com, NasdaqGS:AMZN, has completed its acquisition of satellite operator Globalstar. The deal gives Amazon control of Globalstar’s spectrum rights, satellite fleet, and key commercial agreements.
summary_zh: 亚马逊（NasdaqGS：AMZN）已完成对卫星运营商 Globalstar 的收购。该交易使亚马逊能够控制 Globalstar 的频谱权、卫星群和关键商业协议。

title: Goldman Sachs’ blunt words for Amazon stock investors after big deal
title_zh: 高盛在大宗交易后对亚马逊股票投资者的直言不讳
summary: Amazon (AMZN) just completed a massive new deal, and Goldman Sachs thinks investors need to see the bigger picture.
summary_zh: 亚马逊（AMZN）刚刚完成了一项大规模的新交易，高盛认为投资者需要看到更大的前景。
